author: mark
text:
Extract lernie-provider-anthropic to its own workspace crate

The Anthropic client, adapter, and binary move out of the root `lernie`
crate into `crates/lernie-provider-anthropic/`, which compiles
independently. Drops the `crate::config` coupling (and the dead
`Client::from_provider` path) so the adapter has no dependency on
harness internals — per PRINCIPLES.md "Integrations are external
binaries". Root temporarily depends on the subcrate for the `Response`
type that `src/prompt/mod.rs` consumes; ball bl-bf79 removes that dep
via a neutral wire-type module. Tests and binaries land in the shared
workspace target; 100% tarpaulin holds.
